name: Impatient (Magic Weapon Quality)
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Price +1 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

These weapons are especially useful to not just thieves and assassins, but anyone who may need to end a fight quickly.

While wielding an impatient weapon you gain a +2 bonus on initiative checks and a +2 bonus on damage rolls with the weapon during a surprise round. In addition an impatient weapon can be drawn as part of making an initiative check, though you do not get the +2 bonus unless the weapon was already in hand.

The bonuses provided by multiple impatient weapons do not stack.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Improved Initiative
